text:
Sasha: Kicking off Aurora POC. Customer requires Private/VPC deployment. Non-negotiables: preserve original client IP for audit/rate-limits, no TLS interception, and a single stable egress IP for their allowlist. Need a short topology recommendation + firewall snippet they can paste to NetOps.

Mike: Options to surface: 1) VPC Peering/Transit (preserves client IP end-to-end), 2) AWS PrivateLink (interface endpoints; simpler cross-account but endpoint ENI IPs appear as source), 3) NLB in TCP passthrough mode + proxy-protocol or managed egress proxy with static EIP.

Elaine: PrivateLink is great for isolation but note it changes source to endpoint ENIs. If exact client IP is required, prefer peering or NLB+proxy-protocol.

Raj: Minimal firewall snippet to send to their NetOps (replace placeholders with our CIDRs/EIPs):

Sasha: ```text
Outbound allow from on-prem/spoke -> Redwood service:
- Protocol: TCP
- Ports: 443 (HTTPS) outbound to service subnets
- Example dest CIDRs (replace): 10.254.10.0/24, 10.254.11.0/24
- Peering note: do NOT NAT source if you need original client IP preserved
- If using egress NAT/proxy: allow outbound to static EIP(s) we provide (TCP 443)
```

Mike: NLB+proxy-protocol callout: use internal TCP NLB, enable Proxy Protocol v2, app must parse proxy header to recover original IP. SGs: client->NLB:443, NLB->targets:443.

Elaine: Cost note for quote: PrivateLink = hourly endpoint + per-GB processing; NAT Gateway/egress proxy = per-hour + per-GB egress; Peering usually lowest infra cost but needs cross-account routing setup. We should include a simple cost delta.

netops-bot: Playbook: https://internal.redwood/privatedeploy-playbook  has onboarding steps, CIDR handoff, IAM and KMS checklist.

Sasha: Next steps: Ill fetch exact CIDRs/EIPs from infra and share with Aurora; Mike will produce cost delta; Elaine will draft SG/router examples and proxy-protocol runtime note. Raj will confirm which constraint is hard stop.

Mike: Will drop cost table by EOD.

Elaine: Will add SG examples and a one-paragraph runtime note.
